title: Tasmanian minimum standards for rentals
description: Checks against the minimum standards a Tasmanian rental must meet before it is rented out, under Part 3B of the Residential Tenancy Act 1997. Summarised from Consumer Affairs Tasmania guidance.

items.title: Weatherproof: no leaking roof, large gaps or open old fireplaces
Clean, and in good repair with no safety or sanitation problems
Working flushing toilet in a separate ventilated room, and a bathroom
Kitchen with sink, hot and cold water, oven and stove top
items.detail: At least 2 elements for 2 or fewer bedrooms, 3 for 3 or more.

items.title: Safe, working mains electricity, power points and wiring
Adequate light in each room except storage rooms and garages
Fixed electric or gas heater, heat pump or wood heater in the main living area (not an open fire)
Blinds or curtains on bedroom and living room windows
Ventilation of at least 5% of floor area, with windows that lock open securely
Compliant smoke alarms installed and working
Record the condition in the condition report with dated photos
